How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your jewellery for the first time is so exciting! Here are some tips to make the most of it:
Unbox with Care: Your piece will arrive in a lovely presentation box or envelope. Handle it gently to avoid tangling or scratching.
Wear Last: Put your jewellery on after applying perfumes, lotions, or makeup to keep it looking its best.
Daily Use: If it’s stainless steel, it’s water and sweat-resistant, so it’s perfect for everyday wear. For other materials, avoid water and harsh chemicals.
Storage: When not wearing it, store your piece in its box to protect it from dust and scratches.
Enjoy showing off your gorgeous new jewellery! Let me know if you need more tips. 🧡
